entityDescription:
We are Cartool Maschinenbau GmbH, an experienced and well-coordinated team that implements the development, design, and production of machines, systems, and components.With passion, we create customer solutions and combine them with competent project management. Our many years of experience in mechanical engineering allow us to tailor solutions to the needs of our customers, ensuring the best possible results.Comprehensive know-how, creative solutions, and flexibility are our strengths, making us a reliable and versatile partner for our customers.

Development and Design
We turn your ideas into finished products. With good ideas, rich mechanical engineering experience, and Computer Aided Design, we are your partner for streamlined development processes and successful projects. We are creative and innovative, leveraging our expertise in various fields to achieve success with you. Even at the design stage, we support you to eliminate sources of error in material selection or manufacturing processes. Every step in the development is carefully considered, resulting in the optimal solution – efficient and cost-effective.

Individual and Series Parts
Milling and turning parts are the daily business of a mechanical engineer and are thus part of our daily tasks, as well as manufacturing techniques like 3D printing and component finishing through special surface treatments. From ASAP production deadlines to extended workbench with stock retrieval. We are happy to support you and adapt to your processes. We advise our customers on the choice of processing technique. Whether milling, turning, welding, bending, gluing, or screwing, we always seek the best solution for your needs together with you. In doing so, we draw on our expertise in all aspects of mechanical engineering.

Workpiece Carriers
From prototypes to series-ready development, we are happy to support you with our know-how. Development and design of workpiece carriers according to customer requirements. We do not shy away from great product variety and complex clamping options. Over 15 years of practical experience help us implement your requirements for practical use. We develop and supply workpiece carriers for fixing the most diverse workpieces, from small and precise to heavy and cumbersome. With our workpiece carriers, components can be further processed, transported, or stored accurately and gently. The use of CTM workpiece carriers enables both manual and automated production processes. By coordinating with your production processes, quality and manufacturing costs remain in balance.

entityDescription:
The Fondazione Edmund Mach (FEM) is a leading Italian institution active in research, technology, and technology transfer related to the agro-food sector. FEM is a public agency under private law jurisdiction. FEM comprises a Research and Innovation Centre (CRI), a Training and Education Centre, and a Technology Transfer Centre, all carrying out activities in the fields of agro-food and sustainable development. Currently, FEM makes up a full-scale rural centre stretching out over a 14-hectare campus, with classrooms, greenhouses, offices. FEM owns 120 hectares of land cultivated with apple and grape and 80ha of forests. Nowadays around 800 students attend classes, assisted by over 100teachers. 58% of FEM personnel are males. The majority of collaborators are 30-50 years old. 15% percent is of foreign nationality. The Edmund Mach Foundation is organized into Centers geared to the specific aims of: 1. Education and Training (CIF); 2. Research and Innovation (CRI); 3. Technical Experimentation and Transfer (CTT). Today, the goal of improving the characteristics and potential of agriculture is reached through the integration between the school, the Research and Innovation Centre (CRI), and the technical support provided to companies and farms. FEM promotes and enhances, through research and innovation, the Trentino-land based economy in Italy, aiming at the improvement of agricultural and forestry productions and the improvement of the quality and nutritional value of food products. It also supports the region’s environmental resources through the development and promotion of low-impact agricultural practices, the study and preservation of biodiversity and the characterization of the alpine and subalpine ecosystems.FEM expresses research capacities at the highest international and national levels, as witnessed by a third-party official evaluation in 2022 (ANVUR): FEM ranked 18th (out of 65) in chemistry, 7th in agricultural and veterinary sciences (out of 39), and 3rd (out of 75) in biology, at the national level, when compared with all the involved institution. FEM ranked 4th overall within the above mentioned scientific groups when compared to homologous institutions.

In the coming 3 years (from 2022 to 2025) FEM will play a pivotal role at National level in the deployment of the activities related to research within the EU Recovery Funds and EU Green Deal framework. FEM will be involved in 3 major initiatives. entityName: University of Aplied Sciences Hrvatsko zagorje Krapina
entityDescription:
The Study Programmes
The University runs three bachelor study programmes:
- Information Science
- Traffic Logistics
- Operational Management.
The main purpose is educating young experts who will eventually assume leadership of the business and infrastructure sectors representing the core of the economic and societal development of the Krapinsko-zagorska County.
The education programme for our students is based on exploring disciplines necessary for successful management of business operations related to traffic logistics, enterprise and information technology. The selection of specific subjects, their distribution per study year and the exploration span of each discipline are a harmonised principally with the defined needs of the student. Core disciplines such as mathematics, statistics, foreign languages, information science and economy provide students with general knowledge necessary in everyday trade. Specific subjects ensure the acquisition of competences necessary for successful professional performance and the performance of complex expert operations as well as specific knowledge needed for the further economic development of the County.
The documents, the work and the structure of the institution are completely congruent with the principles of the Bologna Declaration. The students receive 180 ECTS upon completion of the study programme, therefore satisfying the criteria for further postgraduate and doctoral studies.
The classes are held in small groups and the University has as its disposal space and equipment above the Croatian average. All main course holders are ether MA or PhD with tenure, lecturer, assistant professor or professor status. All classes are held in Krapina.
The institution is not allowed to divide profits among founders. It has the obligation to re-invest it in improving the study conditions.
The University is compatible with similar institutions within the EU, allowing it to engage in student exchanges, such as the Erasmus programme and other EU programmes, possibly also through bilateral agreements.

Development
The University is open for developing further study programmes. With the amendment of the founding contract, the County gained a leading role in proposing and inciting the development of new study programmes in the interest of developing the whole area of the County.
Within the bigger picture of the development of the County, the University represents a knowledge centre. There are many experts based in the County that had to seek work in Zagreb. They showed good will to get involved in the work of the University and become the core around which high expertise is developed and at the same time the motivation for further postgraduate studying that will inevitably result in a higher number of expert higher-educated people in the County.
Opening of the University “Hrvatsko zagorje Krapina” led to the advancement of the economic and social status of the citizens, together with the advancement of education and the improvement of the quality of life. All of these features result in motivating the higher-educated professionals for staying in the County.
The study programmes per se empower young experts for employment and entrepreneurial initiative.

entityDescription:
The Faculty of Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering at CTU in Prague was founded in 1955 as one of the essential parts of the Czechoslovakian nuclear programme. It became an excellent scientific institute that mainly focused on mathematics, physics, nuclear chemistry, materials, electronics, IT and nuclear reactors. It combines excellent science with educating future experts.

The faculty has unique facilities that attract scientists and students from all over the world. Not only a school fission reactor or a Golem tokamak. We also have state-of-the-art chemical laboratories, laser laboratories, fractography workplaces, a centre for detection systems, PlasmaLab@CTU, a quantum laboratory and many others, which we continue to improve and expand.

entityName: Competency Center for Advanced Engineering Nova Gradiška d.o.o.
entityDescription:
CEKOM NING, headquartered in Nova Gradiška, Croatia, is a leading organization dedicated to research, development, and innovation in advanced engineering. Established as a pivotal element of regional innovation infrastructure, CEKOM NING operates as a center for excellence, fostering technological advancement, knowledge dissemination, and industrial collaboration.
The organization specializes in high-speed metal processing, additive manufacturing, robotics, automation, and thermal treatment of materials. CEKOM NING offers a comprehensive suite of services, including education and training programs, contractual research for SMEs, and the development of innovative solutions for industry challenges.
CEKOM NING has built a robust track record of successful projects, including the flagship initiative, Competence Centre for Advanced Engineering Nova Gradiška, a €15.8 million project aimed at enhancing R&D infrastructure, promoting private sector investment in innovation, and driving economic growth. The organization has collaborated with renowned academic institutions such as FERIT Osijek, the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture in Zagreb, and regional high schools, thereby strengthening its ties with the academic and industrial sectors.
In 2024 alone, CEKOM NING provided training to over 200 participants, supported six startups through advanced engineering expertise, and extended its network of collaborators. The organization remains committed to addressing the skills gap in Industry 4.0, robotics, and automation by developing non-formal education programs in collaboration with national employment agencies.
